summary: Group 1 Automotive filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary Group 1 Realty entered a master credit agreement with Bank of America effective September 23, 2026, providing a $190,336,250 term loan equal to 85% of appraised mortgaged-property value. Interest accrues at Term SOFR plus 145 basis points; the facility matures September 23, 2033, is non-revolving, secured by mortgages and fixtures, and guaranteed by the parent. Covenants restrict liens, dispositions, and mergers, with customary cross-default provisions. This is a routine real-estate-backed financing, not a special situation; watch leverage and covenant headroom.
